description:
Western SVG, PNG, DXF EPS Files – Western T-Shirt Design
These files are compatible with all major cutting machines like Cricut, Silhouette Cameo, and other cutting machines.
you will receive a ZIP folder, which includes

These Designs are Great for, T-shirts, Mugs, Signs, Wall Art, Bags, Birthday Cards, Wall Decals, Vinyl Decals, Car Decals, Stickers, Party Decorations, Iron-on, Scrapbooking, Print N’ Cuts, and More!
Please make sure you know at least one of the file types, including opening and using the files. make sure your machine and software are compatible before purchasing.
Thank you!
